title: Learn Backend with Python
tagline: FastAPI or Django APIs from first route to production services
description: A three-level curriculum for building backend services with Python — from HTTP and SQL through authenticated APIs to systems you can test, cache, observe, and ship. FastAPI is the primary path; Django/DRF patterns are covered where they differ.
prerequisites: Comfort using a terminal, Git, and a code editor
Willingness to install Python 3.11+, pip/uv, and a local PostgreSQL instance

levels.title: HTTP, SQL & First APIs
levels.goal: Stand up a small HTTP API that reads and writes real data

topics.title: Python for services
items: Typing, dataclasses, async/await, and packages
Virtual environments (venv/uv) and dependency files
Error handling, logging, and project layout

topics.title: How the web talks
items: HTTP methods, status codes, and headers
JSON request and response bodies
REST principles: resources, URLs, and idempotency

topics.title: SQL & relational design
items: Tables, primary keys, and foreign keys
SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, and GROUP BY
Indexes you actually need on day one

topics.title: Framework basics
items: FastAPI routes, path/query params, and dependency injection
Pydantic models for request/response schemas
Alternative path: Django views/serializers at a glance

topics.title: Talking to PostgreSQL
items: SQLAlchemy (or Django ORM) with parameterized queries
Sessions, engines, and connection pooling basics
First migrations with Alembic or Django

topics.title: Git & API clients
items: Branch, commit, and PR habits for backend teams
Exploring endpoints with Postman, Bruno, or httpx
Docker Compose for a local Postgres

projects: CRUD API for members or products with Postgres
OpenAPI docs (FastAPI auto-docs or DRF schema)
Docker Compose so a teammate can run the API locally

levels.title: Authenticated, Tested Services
levels.goal: Ship APIs with auth, validation, migrations, and tests you trust

topics.title: Authentication
items: Password hashing (passlib/argon2) and sessions vs. JWT
OAuth/OIDC at a working level
Refresh tokens, expiry, and logout

topics.title: Authorization
items: Role-based dependencies or permission classes
Resource ownership checks
Least privilege for service accounts

topics.title: ORM and schema change
items: Models mapped to tables without leaking SQL injection
Forward-only migrations and careful rollbacks
Transactions for multi-step writes

topics.title: Validation & errors
items: Pydantic (or DRF serializers) at the boundary
Consistent error shapes and HTTP status mapping
Idempotent creates for retries

topics.title: pytest for APIs
items: Unit tests for domain logic
TestClient / AsyncClient against the app
Fixtures and a disposable test database

topics.title: API contracts
items: OpenAPI as the source of truth
Contract tests for breaking changes
Seed data that matches production shapes

topics.title: Redis and workers
items: When to cache vs. when to fix the query
Celery/RQ job enqueue for slow work
EXPLAIN and slow-query awareness

projects: REST API with JWT/session auth, roles, and pytest coverage
Migration-backed schema for a real feature
Background job that processes a webhook payload

levels.title: Production-Grade Backend Systems
levels.goal: Design services that stay correct under load, retries, and money-moving traffic

topics.title: Service boundaries
items: Monolith vs. modular packages vs. services
Synchronous APIs vs. async workers
Outbox pattern for reliable side effects

topics.title: Queues and workers
items: Celery/RQ/SQS retries and dead-letter queues
Idempotency keys for at-least-once delivery
Poison message handling

topics.title: API security
items: Injection, mass assignment, and secrets in env
Rate limiting, CORS, and webhook signature verification
PII handling and audit logs

topics.title: Ledger-style consistency
items: Immutable ledger rows vs. mutable balances
Idempotent payment and transfer endpoints
Reconciliation when callbacks are late or duplicated

topics.title: Logs, metrics, traces
items: Structured logging with request IDs
Prometheus metrics or OpenTelemetry
Tracing across handlers and workers

topics.title: Containers and config
items: Multi-stage Docker images and non-root users
12-factor config and graceful shutdown (uvicorn/gunicorn)
Health checks and migrations in CI

projects: SACCO member and savings API with role-based access
Containerized FastAPI/Django service with CI pytest and OpenAPI
